subject: Singapore supplier GST registration + virtual account onboarding
messages:
From: Wei Tan <wei.tan@meridian-payments.sg>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: accounts@meridian-payments.sg
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 09:12:00 +0800
Subject: Next steps for GST evidence and virtual account setup

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for confirming the PO commitment for Meridian Payments. To complete our supplier profile and activate the SGD virtual account for PO-4782 we need the following items from Redwood:

- Signed supplier onboarding form (we attach a template we normally use)
- Redwood legal entity name and local tax registration ID that should appear on invoices
- Billing address used for the PO
- Preferred remittance instructions and contact for payment queries (email + phone)

From our side we can provide: Meridian's Singapore GST registration certificate and a bank confirmation letter for the virtual account. I have attached the GST cert and a short confirmation PDF showing the virtual account number allocated to Redwood.

If you can confirm who on your finance team will complete the onboarding form (and if any PO field needs to be pre-populated), we can kick off the activation right away.

Best,
Wei Tan
Partnerships, Meridian Payments Pte Ltd
attachments: meridian_gst_certificate.pdf, virtual_account_confirmation.pdf

From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
To: Wei Tan <wei.tan@meridian-payments.sg>
Cc: rachel.kim@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 10:03:00 +0800
Subject: Re: Next steps for GST evidence and virtual account setup

Hi Wei — thanks for the docs and for outlining the requirements. Quick answers and next steps from our side: 

- We will return a completed supplier_onboarding_form.xlsx by EOD Tuesday (28 Apr). Rachel (cc'd) will own the form and populate Redwood's billing address and legal tax ID.
- For invoicing: please make invoices payable to "Redwood Inference, Inc." and include our Singapore branch UEN: 2027-99-REDWOOD-SG (this is the entity that Meridian will bill).
- The PO field that needs to be pre-populated is the "Bill To Entity" and the PO number (PO-4782). If you can accept invoices showing the virtual account reference, that will speed reconciliation.

Karthik — can you confirm whether we need any additional tax residency paperwork for Meridian (IRAS-specific) before finance will approve payments into the virtual account?

Wei — once we send the completed form we expect Procurement/AP to finalize the onboarding and confirm activation. If you need an additional vendor contact for KYC, please let us know.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Sales Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0199

From: Wei Tan <wei.tan@meridian-payments.sg>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, rachel.kim@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 14:22:00 +0800
Subject: Re: Next steps for GST evidence and virtual account setup

Hi Laura / Rachel,

Thanks — attached are the two PDFs we discussed: meridian_gst_certificate.pdf and virtual_account_confirmation.pdf. The GST certificate shows the registration number and effective date; IRAS typically accepts a copy of that together with the vendor banking confirmation.

Regarding IRAS: Meridian is GST-registered in Singapore and invoices will carry GST where applicable. If Redwood's billing entity is GST-registered locally, invoices may need to include Redwood's GST number. Otherwise, standard billed amounts apply and GST is remit-able by Meridian.

For KYC, if Procurement/AP needs an additional letter (company profile on letterhead and UEN verification), I can get that over within 24 hours.

Attached: meridian_gst_certificate.pdf, virtual_account_confirmation.pdf

Regards,
Wei Tan
Partnerships, Meridian Payments Pte Ltd

From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
To: accounts@meridian-payments.sg, Wei Tan <wei.tan@meridian-payments.sg>
Cc: rachel.kim@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, procurement@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 16:05:00 +08:00
Subject: Redwood onboarding form + PO-4782: action required to activate virtual account

Hi Procurement / Meridian accounts team —

Following up to hand this to Procurement/AP for vendor activation. Attachments: completed supplier_onboarding_form.xlsx (filled by Redwood), plus copies of the vendor-provided GST cert and virtual account confirmation.

Procurement (procurement@redwood.ai): please confirm the following so we can mark the vendor "active" in Coupa and enable the virtual account for PO-4782:

1) Verify bank confirmation PDF and virtual account number match Meridian's record.
2) Confirm vendor tax evidence is acceptable for AP (meridian_gst_certificate.pdf). If finance needs IRAS-specific attestation, please request it from Wei.
3) Create vendor record with Bill To Entity = "Redwood Inference Singapore Branch" and attach PO-4782 to the onboarding packet.

Wei / Meridian: once Procurement confirms activation, please send a test invoice referencing PO-4782 and the virtual account reference so we can confirm automated reconciliation.

Thanks everyone — Rachel will monitor and close the loop from our side.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Sales Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
attachments: supplier_onboarding_form.xlsx
